name: RedactSense
summary: On-device AI redaction for macOS and Windows: finds and permanently removes sensitive information without uploading files to the cloud.
description: On-device AI redaction for macOS and Windows: finds and permanently removes sensitive information without uploading files to the cloud.

pricing.details: Free forever, no card (unlimited documents, first 2 pages exported, 1 device). Individual 18 €/month billed annually (all pages, all styles, 1 device). Team 36 € per device per month billed annually (min. 2 devices, admin management, priority support). Enterprise custom. A monthly toggle exists; a separate non-discounted monthly amount is not published, so it is not shown.
